Huisvestingsverordening Deventer 2026 is current from 7 February 2026 through 6 February 2030.
Chapter 4 contains opkoopbescherming: qualifying protected housing may not be rented/given into use without a permit during the first four years after registration of the deed.
The regulation contains permit content, statutory permit grounds, withdrawal rules and links compliance to the Wet goed verhuurderschap.
Threshold/scope details must be read from the current article 23 and associated current text before encoding an address-level outcome.
Huisvestingsverordening Diemen 2026 is current from 1 July 2026.
The regulation contains tourist-rental/short-stay rules and a distinct opkoopbescherming section.

Opkoopbescherming lasts four years and currently covers qualifying cheap dwellings up to €355,000 WOZ and mid-priced dwellings from €355,000 through €512,000 WOZ, subject to acquisition/use conditions and exclusions.
Short stay is prohibited outside the permitted framework/complexes specified by the regulation; B&B has separate conditions including a maximum share/area and guest limit.
Because multiple regimes interact, Diemen requires article-level deep review before definitive product encoding.
